description: Climate FieldView is a commercial digital farming platform that collects data from farm machinery and other sources, maps fields, and supports decisions during the season. Its features include a data inbox and data manager for yield and machine data, yield analysis and field region reports, field health imagery, historical weather and forecasts for each field, record-based and image-enhanced scouting, seed scripts and other variable-rate prescriptions, grain futures and a digital map book, with the FieldView Drive 2.0 device and adapter kits linking tractors and combines. It is provided by Climate LLC. It is offered in countries across the Americas, Europe, Africa and Oceania. The Basic plan is free after creating an account and the Plus plan starts at 649 US dollars a year, with external API connectivity for linking other tools. Caveats: it is proprietary and data stay on the vendor's cloud under its terms, and the pages read are marketing material that give no detail on data formats. For simulation it holds field-level yield, prescription and machine records that farm digital twins and crop models use, and its weather and imagery layers support analysis of how drought and storms affect farm output. It is related to the farmOS record in this catalogue, an open-source farm record system.
